service_contract_schema_validation.evidence: ServiceContract validates the adl.runtime.service_contract.v1 schema and rejects empty service/configuration identities before contract aggregation.

component_surface_binding.evidence: service_contract_must_match_component_runtime_surface and topology registry construction prove contract component identity, ports, and failure policy must match the Runtime v3 component spec.

capability_matching.evidence: compatible_capabilities_resolve_independent_of_registration_order and multiple_capability_providers_allow_compatible_selection prove semver-compatible capability resolution independent of registration order.

fail_closed_capability_requirements.evidence: required_capabilities_fail_closed_when_missing_or_incompatible proves missing and incompatible required capabilities fail closed; optional_capability_may_be_absent proves optional requirements do not block construction.

duplicate_contract_rejection.evidence: duplicate_services_and_local_capabilities_are_rejected proves duplicate service identities and duplicate local capabilities are rejected.

configuration_schema_rejection.evidence: runtime_configuration_rejects_version_shape_identity_and_secrets proves unsupported schemas, unknown fields, duplicate component identities, and secret-like canonical parameters are rejected.

canonical_configuration_projection.evidence: configuration_keeps_runtime_bindings_outside_canonical_projection and declarative_registry_builds_contract_checked_topology_canonically prove deterministic canonical JSON without runtime bindings or secret fields.

factory_registry_fail_closed.evidence: configured_registry_fails_closed_for_factory_and_surface_drift proves missing factories, duplicate factories, and factory/component identity drift fail before runtime start.

deterministic_topology_build.evidence: declarative_registry_builds_contract_checked_topology_canonically proves the configured registry builds the same effective topology independent of input component order.

non_claims: This packet does not authorize Runtime v3 as the default runtime.
This packet does not delete or decommission Runtime v2.
This packet does not claim distributed multi-node residence, guardian federation, or polis-level resilience.
This packet does not count blocker or deferred dispositions as passed parity.
